author: National Geographic
description:
Paid content for @ExploreCanada. What makes a photograph authentic? On a journey across scenic Canada, three National Geographic photographers explore how place, people, and stories can reveal deeper truths through the camera lens.

Kiliii Yüyan travels to Iceberg Alley, capturing the striking beauty of icebergs from above by helicopter. Matthieu Paley reflects on the diversity of the people he meets along the way, from musicians in Newfoundland to local communities, and shares how he photographs subjects in natural moments. Finally, Ami Vitale emphasizes the importance of listening, explaining how trust and connection can guide photographers toward the stories that matter most.

Their journeys reveal that authenticity isn’t something we create, it’s something we recognize when we’re present enough to see it. author: National Geographic
description:
The Saguaro National Park in Arizona was created to protect the saguaro cactus, an icon of the American southwest. Towering over the Arizona desert, the iconic saguaro cactus stands as the sentinel of this National Park, anchoring a rich wilderness filled with hidden drama and ancient history. In this updated full episode of America's National Parks, join park rangers as they unveil the park's hidden gems and reveal how conservationists are protecting its namesake cacti, preserving the future of this majestic Southwestern landscape.

America's National Parks | S1 E6
